name: DAW Project Manager
tagline: Track and organize your DAW projects across every studio
blurb: DAW Project Manager scans your drives for music production projects — Ableton Live, Cubase, FL Studio, Logic Pro, Bitwig, Pro Tools, Reaper, Studio One, and over twenty other DAWs
description:
DAW Project Manager scans your drives for music production projects —
Ableton Live, Cubase, FL Studio, Logic Pro, Bitwig, Pro Tools, Reaper,
Studio One, and over twenty other DAWs — and keeps them organized in one
dashboard.

Track project phases and deadlines, tag releases, manage a task queue
per project, sync your library across machines with Google Drive, and
browse everything with filtering, search, and playlists for quick
A/B listening.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
